verses.greek_plain: δικαιουμενοι δωρεαν τη αυτου χαριτι δια τησ απολυτρωσεωσ τησ εν χω ιυ
verses.english_web: being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus;
verses.english_adapted: being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus;

verses.greek_plain: ον προεθετο ο θσ ιλαστη ριον δια τησ πιστεωσ εν τω αυτου αιματι εισ ενδιξιν τησ δικαιοσυνησ αυτου δια την παρεσιν των προγεγο νοτων αμαρτηματων
verses.english_web: whom God sent to be an atoning sacrifice, through faith in his blood, for a demonstration of his righteousness through the passing over of prior sins, in God’s forbearance;
verses.english_adapted: whom God sent to be an atoning sacrifice, through faith in his blood, for a demonstration of his righteousness through the passing over of prior sins, in God’s forbearance;

verses.greek_plain: εν τη ανο χη του θεου προσ την ενδει ξιν τησ δικαιοσυνησ αυτου εν τω νυν καιρω εισ το ειναι αυτον δικαιον και δικαι ουντα τον εκ πιστεωσ ιυ
verses.english_web: to demonstrate his righteousness at this present time; that he might himself be just, and the justifier of him who has faith in Jesus.
verses.english_adapted: to demonstrate his righteousness at this present time; that he might himself be just, and the justifier of him who has faith in Jesus.

verses.greek_plain: που ουν η καυχησισ εξεκλεισθη δια ποιου νομου των εργων ουχι αλλα δια νομου πιστεωσ
verses.english_web: Where then is the boasting? It is excluded. By what kind of law? Of works? No, but by a law of faith.
verses.english_adapted: Where then is the boasting? It is excluded. By what kind of law? Of works? No, but by a law of faith.

verses.greek_plain: λογιζομεθα γαρ δικαιουσθαι πιστει ανον χωρισ εργων νομου
verses.english_web: We maintain therefore that a man is justified by faith apart from the works of the law.
verses.english_adapted: We maintain therefore that a man is justified by faith apart from the works of the law.

verses.greek_plain: η ιουδαιων ο θσ μονον ουχι και εθνων ναι και εθνων
verses.english_web: Or is God the God of Jews only? Isn’t he the God of Gentiles also? Yes, of Gentiles also,
verses.english_adapted: Or is God the God of Jews only? Isn’t he the God of Gentiles also? Yes, of Gentiles also,

verses.greek_plain: ειπερ εισ ο θσ οσ δικαιωσει πε ριτομην εκ πιστεωσ και ακρο βυστιαν δια τησ πιστεωσ
verses.english_web: since indeed there is one God who will justify the circumcised by faith, and the uncircumcised through faith.
verses.english_adapted: since indeed there is one God who will justify the circumcised by faith, and the uncircumcised through faith.

verses.greek_plain: μη γενοιτο αλλα νομον ιστα νομεν
verses.english_web: Do we then nullify the law through faith? May it never be! No, we establish the law.
verses.english_adapted: Do we then nullify the law through faith? May it never be! No, we establish the law.

verses.greek_plain: τι ουν ερουμεν ευ ρηκεναι
verses.english_web: What then will we say that Abraham, our forefather, has found according to the flesh?
verses.english_adapted: What then will we say that Abraham, our forefather, has found according to the flesh?

verses.greek_plain: ει γαρ αβρααμ εξ εργων εδικαιωθη εχει καυχημα αλλ ου προσ θεον
verses.english_web: For if Abraham was justified by works, he has something to boast about, but not toward God.
verses.english_adapted: For if Abraham was justified by works, he has something to boast about, but not toward God.

verses.greek_plain: τι γαρ η γραφη λεγει επιστευσεν δε αβρααμ τω θω και ελογισθη αυτω εισ δικαιοσυνην
verses.english_web: For what does the Scripture say? “Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.”
verses.english_adapted: For what does the Scripture say? “Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.”

verses.greek_plain: τω δε εργαζο μενω ο μισθοσ ου λογιζεται κατα χαριν αλλα κατα οφιλη μα
verses.english_web: Now to him who works, the reward is not counted as grace, but as something owed.
verses.english_adapted: Now to him who works, the reward is not counted as grace, but as something owed.

verses.greek_plain: τω δε εργαζομενω ου λο γιζεται ο μισθοσ κατα χαριν πιστευοντι δε επι τον δικαι ουντα τον ασεβη λογιζεται η πιστισ εαυτου εισ δικαιο συνην
verses.english_web: But to him who doesn’t work, but believes in him who justifies the ungodly, his faith is accounted for righteousness.
verses.english_adapted: But to him who doesn’t work, but believes in him who justifies the ungodly, his faith is accounted for righteousness.
